conservative.read: This conservative plan targets approximately 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, aiming for lower drawdown. Expect steady, but modest, returns with reduced volatility.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets approximately 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this mode carries substantially higher drawdown risk and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay, meaning losses can accumulate rapidly if not managed with strict stops.

plan: Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Sell all SOXL and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETF risk.

income.read: This income plan targets approximately 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdown by rotating into income ETFs and reducing high-beta names. Remember, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
